summary.vibehub: Crisp borders, a split workspace and quick feedback.
summary.uiux-pro: Soft surfaces, restrained shadows and clear hierarchy.
summary.ascii: A terminal-style interface: borders, buttons, background and motion are all drawn with ASCII characters, with a boot sequence.
summary.liquid-glass: A translucent glass interface: buttons and the pointer droplet attract each other and fuse when they get close.
summary.palettes: Choose accent colors for light and dark modes.
summary.motion: Control transitions, hover effects and click animations.
summary.theme-transition: Animate light and dark mode changes while keeping the selected palette.
summary.ocean: Add ocean creatures and gentle background animations.
summary.cursor: Enable pointer effects in the VibeHub theme.
summary.tag-heat: Highlight frequently visited tags by their activity.
summary.hover-card: Preview bookmarks on hover and customize their cards.
summary.url-privacy: Hide or blur URLs in the bookmark interface.
summary.animated-icons: Animated fallback icons for bookmarks without favicons.
summary.agent: Chat with an assistant to find and organize bookmarks.
summary.models: Configure AI services, models and provider connections.
summary.tools: Give assistants tools to search and manage bookmarks and tags.
summary.agent-api: Connect external assistants and automation through REST.
summary.mcp-server: Expose bookmark tools to authorized MCP clients.
summary.mcp-client: Connect external MCP services and select assistant tools.
summary.statistics: View bookmark visit trends, heatmaps, tab statistics and Agent usage.
summary.passkey: Sign in with fingerprints, facial recognition, device PINs, or security keys, and manage registered passkeys.
summary.browser-extension: Download the browser extension and follow the installation guide to save pages and sync tabs.
summary.page-speed: Show page load and route render times in the upper-right corner, with browser timing details.
summary.view-gallery: Adds a gallery view to bookmarks: covers or page screenshots as tiles, with descriptions and tags on hover.
summary.view-timeline: Adds a timeline view to bookmarks, grouped by today, yesterday, the last 7 days and month.
summary.view-domains: Adds a site groups view to bookmarks: bookmarks from the same site share a collapsible group.
summary.view-focus: Adds a focus view to bookmarks: one bookmark at a time, browsed with the left and right arrow keys.
summary.tag-cloud: Adds a tag cloud to the tag sidebar: text size follows usage, so frequent tags stand out.
summary.tag-bars: Adds a tag ranking to the tag sidebar: one tag per row, with bars comparing bookmark or click counts.
summary.tab-board: Adds a board layout to tab groups: one column per group, with tabs draggable between columns.
summary.tab-compact: Adds a compact list to tab groups: each group is a single row that expands to show its tabs.
summary.home-topbar: Home layout: no sidebar. Tags become a horizontal strip under the toolbar and bookmarks use the full width.
summary.home-launchpad: Home layout: a start page with a centered search box, frequent tags and quick access, followed by all bookmarks.
summary.home-reader: Home layout: three panes with tags on the left, a compact list in the middle and bookmark details on the right.
summary.home-tagboard: Home layout: a board with one column per tag that scrolls horizontally.
summary.home-canvas: Home layout: tags and bookmarks laid out on an infinite canvas you can pan and zoom, free of the screen size.
summary.tabs-tabbed: Tab groups layout: groups become a strip along the top, content uses the full width, and the group tree and to-dos move into drawers.
summary.tabs-wall: Tab groups layout: all groups as a multi-column wall of cards, with tabs draggable between cards.
summary.tabs-timeline: Tab groups layout: a timeline by saved date: today, yesterday, last 7 days and each month.
summary.tabs-canvas: Tab groups layout: every group is a card on an infinite canvas you can pan, zoom and arrange freely.

title: Custom plugins
subtitle: Install and manage third-party plugins. Built-in features now live in Settings, where each section has its own switches and options.
safeNotice: Optional plugins are skipped on this page. Disable faulty plugins here.
empty: No custom plugins are installed, or none match the filters.
installNote: Users must grant access after installation. Custom sources are marked community. ZIP limit: 16 MiB.
clearConfirm: Delete this plugin's settings, storage and credentials? This cannot be undone.
uninstallConfirm: Uninstall from this instance? User configuration and data will be retained.

imageHosting.intro: Choose which images use S3, Cloudflare R2, MinIO or a generic HTTP image host. Local copies are released after the remote image is verified; failed uploads keep the original image.
imageHosting.scope: Applies to newly saved images. Unchecked types keep local storage or the original URL. Snapshot HTML stays on this server; existing images are not migrated. Covers and favicons are copied only from explicitly saved HTTPS image URLs.
imageHosting.urlPath: Image URL path in the response
imageHosting.authHint: Use Authorization or an X-* header such as X-API-Key; leave empty for no authentication. URL paths support data.url and data.0.url.
imageHosting.secretSaved: Encrypted value saved; leave empty to keep it
imageHosting.secretEmpty: For example, Bearer …; enter the complete header value
imageHosting.grant: Allow selected images to be uploaded to my configured image host
imageHosting.privacy: Selected images are sent to this storage provider. Original URLs on public buckets or CDNs may be publicly accessible. This server still checks image access. Deleting an image here does not remove the provider’s copy.
imageHosting.defaultHint: Used for your signed-in account when no cover or icon is available. Save and enable the plugin first, then upload PNG, JPEG or WebP (up to 2 MiB). The “Custom fallback image” checkbox determines whether it is uploaded to the host.
imageHosting.tooLarge: The fallback image must be at most 2 MiB
imageHosting.pathStyle: Use path-style addressing (recommended for R2 / MinIO)
imageHosting.s3Hint: For AWS S3, use the regional API endpoint and the bucket’s region. For R2, use your account’s r2.cloudflarestorage.com endpoint and region auto. For MinIO, use the HTTPS API endpoint; the region is usually us-east-1. Do not include the bucket in the endpoint.
imageHosting.publicHint: Leave the public URL empty to read a private bucket with server-side signatures. No public bucket permission is needed. A public URL must allow anonymous reads and point to the bucket root; the object prefix is appended automatically.
imageHosting.s3KeysSaved: Encrypted keys saved. Leave both empty to keep them, or enter both to replace them.
imageHosting.s3KeysEmpty: Enter dedicated credentials with object upload and read permissions
imageHosting.keyRetention: Existing private-bucket images retain encrypted read credentials from upload time. Revoking the old key at the storage service will prevent those images from loading. Their read credentials are removed when the corresponding images are deleted here.

paletteSettingsHint: The palette is saved in this browser right away and stays the same across light and dark mode. Turning this off shows the default colour; turning it back on restores your choice.
themeTransitionHint: Controls the reveal animation when switching between light and dark mode; it does not change the palette. With this off you can still switch modes. The animation is also skipped when interface motion is off or the system asks for reduced motion.
inlineSettingsHint: Switches take effect immediately. Features with options can be expanded once they are on; follow each panel to save changes. Collapsing keeps unsaved edits.

detail.jsonHint: Edit the complete configuration directly. The server validates it against the plugin's settings schema on save.
detail.jsonDiscardHint: Going back to the form discards unsaved changes made here.
detail.author: By {{author}}

advanced.title: Credentials and external tool access
advanced.exposureHint: Select tools and exact API Key IDs. This replaces this plugin’s public tool selection. Existing keys gain no access automatically.

marketplace.title: Plugin catalog
marketplace.intro: Bundled official examples are available offline. Additional catalogs are community sources.

featureUnavailableHint: Turn this feature on in Settings to use it. Optional features are hidden temporarily in safe mode.

pageSpeed.documentHint: From browser navigation start to the end of the load event. Excludes later async requests; caching affects the result.
pageSpeed.routeHint: From route change to the initial page render, including lazy modules. Excludes later async data requests and images.

explanation.waiting: Navigate to another page or reload to capture a complete measurement.
explanation.measuring: Waiting for the page to load or render.
explanation.unsupported: This browser does not provide complete navigation timing data.
explanation.interrupted: The page went into the background during measurement. The result was discarded; navigate or reload to retry.
explanation.timeout: Measurement did not complete within 30 seconds. No duration is reported.
